items.title: Pass the Clarity Act
items.summary: Reopening a settled provision four weeks before a vote would sink the bill, argues Summer Mersinger, CEO of the Blockchain Association.

items.title: Solana Just Got Faster—Is It Bullish for SOL?
items.summary: Solana has activated the first reduction in its block timing since launch, speeding up transactions on the network.

items.title: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump Pushes Clarity, SEC Rules, and CFTC Warnings
items.summary: Trump urged executives to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, the CFTC warned it would write its own rules if the bill stalls, and the SEC abruptly advanced its first crypto fundraising framework.

items.title: Strategy Swings From $13 Billion Bitcoin Loss to $1.4 Billion Profit as BTC Rallies
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury giant is sitting on roughly $1.4 billion in unrealized gains after Bitcoin climbed above its average acquisition price.
